小祥！
太好了~你来了！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_1
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我们一直都很担心你哦。
不仅学校那边请假，还完全不回消息——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_2
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
等、等一下……
为什么？发生了什么事……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_3
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……不能跟我们说？
还是说，是因为我们？
如果有做得不好的地方，我们可以改……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_4
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……为什么？
之前的演出，不是很开心吗。
你也说了还想再办的吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_5
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
没说、吗……？
但是，组建CRYCHIC的是小祥哦？
如果小祥退出的话……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_6
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小立希，别这样——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_7
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小立希！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_8
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
等等……！我们好好谈谈吧，好不好？
大家好不容易开开心心走到现在……
小睦也是这么想的吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_9
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……怎么了？你没事吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_11
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
贵安，小睦。
你今天也在打理菜园吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_12
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 这是什么蔬菜？青椒吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_13
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 这样啊。真不愧是园艺社的呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_14
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
昨天，我去了RiNG……
但还是没见到小立希~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_15
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……小睦那边怎么样？
给小祥发的消息，收到回复了吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_16
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
是吗……不回我就算了，
小睦可是她的发小，我还以为她会回呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_17
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小祥现在在哪里呢。
也不知道她好不好

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_18
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
当时……小祥说要退出乐队的时候，
我要是……再多听她述说一下就好了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_19
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 啊……对不起，小睦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_20
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
也不是小睦的错哦。
不要太自责了，好不好？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_21
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
找时间，我去一趟小祥家吧。
小睦，你知道她住哪里吧。能告诉我吗

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_22
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 这样啊。谢谢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_23
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 啊~你是那个在RiNG门口的女生……对吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_24
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小事而已，不用在意的啦——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_25
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
抱歉哦。我朋友给你添麻烦了。
我想她应该也没有恶意……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_26
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
呵呵，没关系的。
突然有人用那种语气对自己说话，
会吓一跳也是正常的吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_27
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
对了，一直站在这里聊天也不合适，
我们去那边的咖啡厅喝个茶吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_28
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯，很厉害呢~
我时不时会看见那个女孩在这里演奏

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_29
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
呵呵，从刚才开始，你就一直在用敬语，
不过我们应该是同龄人吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_30
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
是小爱音呀。
我叫爽世，请多指教~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_31
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……所以，
小爱音在寻找乐队成员吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_32
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
刚才你是不是在看招募成员的公告板？
我猜你是想加入乐队吧~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_33
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那在社交平台上找一找怎么样？
搜索一下的话，会有各种各样位置的招募哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_34
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……因为我以前组过乐队

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_35
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
应该没有那么少见吧。
是在初中的时候，朋友邀请我加入的~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_36
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小爱音是负责什么的？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_37
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
唔~好像没怎么见过
只招募主唱的呢~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_38
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
说起来，我们还什么都没点呢。
我还是老样子，要热伯爵茶

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_39
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小爱音，你大人有大量，别那样瞪着她……
……话说，你们为什么会吵架？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_41
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
莫非，
灯……是指高松灯？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_42
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……我们是朋友

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_43
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……这样啊。原来她在羽丘……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_44
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……你说你邀请了小灯对吧？
你们要一起组乐队吗~？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_45
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我是贝斯手哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_46
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
一般吧~
我就是参加社团活动的时候练一练~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_47
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 好呀~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_48
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 啊，不过一开始应该要从助演开始吧~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_49
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 嗯，好呀~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_50
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……是吗，小灯拒绝了啊~
毕竟她是个敏感的孩子呢~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_51
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小爱音，久等了。
明明是我叫你来，还让你等我，真是抱歉~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_52
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
看，你又变成敬语了哦~
之前我说过，用普通的语气就好了吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_53
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，等等，小立希。
我有事想说，
能占用你一点时间吗

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_54
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯。考虑到乐器的编组，
我觉得要先决定成员才行。
贝斯是我，吉他是小爱音……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_55
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
此外，还需要键盘手。
不过，鼓手的人选我心里已经有了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_56
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……小立希

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_57
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我要和小爱音一起组乐队，
小立希要不要也一起来？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_58
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那个，小立希。
如果我说，小灯也加入的话，你会怎么做？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_59
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……大家都很受伤哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_60
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小立希……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_61
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……嗯。
是和小灯同一个乐队

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_62
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
名字叫CRYCHIC……
你听小灯说过吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_63
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 这样啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_65
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……你能看看这个吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_66
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 嗯，虽然画质有点差……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_67
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
等一下哦，得调整一下镜头位置。
……啊，小睦只入镜了一半哦~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_68
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小立希呢？在调整鼓吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_69
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 是吗，那……小灯呢？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_70
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
而且，就算出错也可以重新拍摄的，
不用紧张啦~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_71
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小立希可真是的！
小灯，加油！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_72
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……不是小灯的错

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_73
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
CRYCHIC解散的事……
谁都没有错哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_74
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 好久不见……小灯

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_75
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……嗯。
今天这样就足够了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_76
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
多亏了小爱音，
我久违地和小灯说上话了……谢谢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_77
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯，乐队解散之后
我们就没联系过

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_78
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小祥也行踪不明，
不知道在哪里……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_79
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 就是视频里那个弹琴的女生哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_80
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你们学校……是指羽丘？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_81
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 这样啊……原来她在羽丘啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_82
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 这个……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_83
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你突然和我搭话的时候，我吓了一跳

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_84
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不过像这样交谈几乎算是第一次呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_85
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 命运……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_86
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯，我知道哦。
她们前段时间在月之森音乐节演奏过对吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_87
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶，原创歌曲吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_88
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我也想看看~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_89
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我没写过歌词，
所以觉得光是能写就很厉害了~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_90
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_91
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 这里是卡拉OK房哦~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_92
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯，小祥找我商量，
我们就想了一个让小灯不紧张的方法~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_93
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
在这里的话，不仅可以练习在别人面前唱歌，
应该也不会像录音棚那样让人紧张吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_94
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
是啊，我们快点唱歌吧。
小睦要唱什么？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_95
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
是呀，就算突然要小灯唱歌，
小灯也会紧张的吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_96
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
所以，大家也点自己要唱的歌吧。
我来点个『もういちど ルミナス』~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_97
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶~小立希也唱嘛。
这首歌一个人唱很难的，帮帮我吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_98
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小睦，你喜欢卡拉OK吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_99
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
还有很多别的灯光哦。
按这里的话，就会从粉色变成黄色~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_100
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小灯，你是不是按到“插队点歌”了？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_101
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 也不紧张了吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_102
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 哇，小睦笑了~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_103
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 歌名是『春日影』？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_104
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……真想快点弹啊

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_105
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
『春日影』也基本完成了呢~
按照这个状态，演出时应该也能唱得很好吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_106
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不然可能会赶不上下次演出的报名时间。
大家都站好站好~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_107
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 好厉害……CRYCHIC太厉害了……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_108
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不会吧……有那么集中？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_109
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……啊，你们看一下社交网站！
有人听了小灯的歌很感动呢！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_110
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
演出的话题下面也有很多反馈哦。
小灯也来看看。大家都写了很多呢~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_111
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
还有人说『会场仿佛融为了一体，好厉害！』~
还有…………啊

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_112
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……啊，但是，
其他人基本都是在夸你——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_113
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……小祥，好久不见

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_114
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我听说你在羽丘，就来找你了。
能聊聊吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_115
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
等等……！
拜托了，只要一会就好……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_116
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
从那之后……
自从小祥不来CRYCHIC之后，
我们一直在找你哦？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_117
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你……为什么转校？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_118
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
为什么，没有跟任何人解释，
就消失了……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_119
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 是因为……CRYCHIC吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_120
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那，为什么……？
你不说的话，我也不知道呀……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_121
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小祥……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_124
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 『爽世同学，你现在在哪里？能来RiNG吗？』

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_125
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 谈谈……谈什么？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_126
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……这样啊。
谢谢，小爱音

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_127
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
也谢谢小灯能来。
我也想继续昨天的话题

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_128
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小灯说，CRYCHIC解散
是自己的错对吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_129
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……小灯原来是这么想的呀。
谢谢你说出来

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_130
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我想，小祥退出乐队，应该有其他理由。
当时我说大家都没错，是真的哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_131
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
所以，我不希望小灯再继续责怪自己了……
也不希望你就这样讨厌乐队

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_132
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小立希也是这么想的吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_133
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……小立希她啊，
就算大家聚在一起的机会变少了，
她也一直在等小灯来练习哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_134
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
呵呵……不是哦。
是因为小立希最喜欢小灯了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_135
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……那个，我们，
能不能再重来一次呢？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_136
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
乐队。
我、小灯、还有小立希

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_137
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我们因为误会而错过，现在终于说开了。
就这样分开也太寂寞了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_138
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 要不要试着再一起组乐队？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_139
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
对呀……！
这次我们好好沟通

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_140
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这样就一定没问题……
大家就可以再组乐队了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_141
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊……
是这样……吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_142
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 一辈子……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_143
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我也发誓

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_144
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……没关系的，不用勉强自己……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_145
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……然后，小立希和小灯
又愿意和我组乐队了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_146
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯。我们不仅听到了小灯的心声，
还好好谈了谈，误会应该也解除了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_147
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯……也谢谢
小睦一直以来的支持

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_148
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
还有，我也找到小祥了哦。
小祥原来在羽丘呢——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_149
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……等大家都聚起来以后，我也会叫小睦的，
再等一下吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_150
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 呵呵，总算前进了一步吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_151
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小立希，冷静一点……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_152
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那个，小爱音。
关于演出，我还想聊聊其他事。比方说——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_154
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 站立的『立』，希望的『希』哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_155
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……别那么说

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_156
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
乐队名也下次再想吧？
大家也差不多该回家了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_157
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 呃……你会弹什么曲子呢？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_158
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那两支乐队主办的演出，
不是很厉害吗

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_159
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
唔……总之，我们先找找能演奏的歌曲吧？
比如翻唱其他乐队的歌曲——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_160
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 但是，那首歌……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_162
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……小爱音也这么说了。
还是找一首对大家来说比较容易的歌曲吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_163
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 等等，小立希……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_164
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
呃……你是不是走错房间了？
这个时间段是我们预约的……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_165
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 那个……你是问玩什么呢……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_166
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 刚才是改编过的吧……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_167
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那个……你是叫要乐奈吧？
你喜欢抹茶芭菲吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_168
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这样啊……
这个女生，就是有时在咖啡厅舞台上演奏的女生吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_169
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 刚才你说玩乐队，是什么意思……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_170
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那个……为什么是加入我们呢？
你弹得那么好，应该也有其他人邀请你吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_171
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶？小乐奈也要走了吗？
等等，再说清楚一点……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_172
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小灯……你说不想举办演出，是为什么……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_173
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……小灯，为什么？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_174
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小灯，谢谢你把自己的想法告诉我们。
你果然很不安呢……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_175
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
但是，这次大家会好好沟通的，不用担心哦？
所以……参加演出试试吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_176
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
CRYCHIC的事情……
真的对小灯打击很大呢……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_177
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
她说不想举办演出……
说举办演出的话，乐队就会结束。
那时候的事，她一直都没放下……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_178
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……不如别参加演出了吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_179
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
就这样，一直不举办演出，
只待在录音棚里玩乐队……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_180
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这样的话，
小灯肯定也能安心吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_181
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小立希……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_182
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……呵呵，
你把这些话告诉小灯不就好了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_183
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……为什么无法把重要的话说出来呢。
就是因为这样，CRYCHIC的大家才会错过彼此……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_184
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 但是，你不想重复同样的事情吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_185
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小立希，把你的想法
都认真告诉小灯吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_186
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
就像小灯的歌打动了小立希一样，
刚才的话肯定也能打动小灯……
她一定会理解你的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_187
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯……
我就知道小立希会这么说的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_188
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 今天，我想好好谈谈今后的事情

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_189
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
现在我们可以算是一盘散沙呢。
这样组乐队还有意义吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_190
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
决定要重新组乐队的时候，
我们不是说了，为了不再有分歧，要好好沟通吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_191
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
可是，我们已经有分歧了……
这样下去的话，又会失败的……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_192
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……总得有人来对她说那些话的。
小立希没有错哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_193
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
好厉害~
你会弹『春日影』了~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_194
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你们跑出去又跑回来，
一起说了『要举办演出』呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_195
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
虽然吓了我一跳，
不过你们能积极面对演出，真是太好了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_196
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
差不多该决定要在演出上演奏什么歌曲了吧？
我找了几首好歌~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_197
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 唔~我觉得练习是可以的……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_198
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
哇……！难道是新歌吗！？
你写好了？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_199
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
呵呵，小灯写的新歌
不是正适合初次演出嘛

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_200
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……你看，小立希。
这是小灯帮我们写的，
属于全新的我们的歌曲哦？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_201
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
虽然现在只有歌词，但我们可以配上乐曲，
让它成为一首完整的歌……
用它来参加让我们永不结束的演出

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_202
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶~小立希好厉害，
难道你会作曲？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_203
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小爱音，感觉不错~
每次练习都发挥更稳定了呢~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_204
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
唔~那要看小立希写的曲子了……
不过我相信小爱音一定能在演出前练好的~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_205
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
之前说的曲子……已经作好了？
小立希真厉害！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_206
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
非常棒~！
我觉得很适合小灯写的词~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_207
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
只是稍微看了一下乐谱，
就能做出这样的编曲……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_208
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 是小灯和小爱音啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_209
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不，没什么哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_210
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我来附近有点事，
所以就想，要不要和你们两个一起去录音棚呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_211
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
好不容易聚在一起了，
大家一起练吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_212
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小乐奈的演奏，
应该不用担心吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_213
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶~我明明很努力啊~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_214
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 她真的像猫一样呢~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_215
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯……小乐奈
也没有在群里发消息

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_216
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 但是，也有可能只是像之前那样迟到哦？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_217
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你们两个都冷静一点

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_218
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我明白你着急的心情。
毕竟小立希是最努力的呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_219
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 但是，我们太依赖小立希了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_220
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……有什么我们能帮忙的事吗？
大家一起做就能做到了吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_221
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我不是这个意思……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_222
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……不行，
小立希不接电话……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_223
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小立希太勉强自己了呢……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_224
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
很紧张呢~
大家做好准备了吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_225
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
对不起哦。
小立希紧张的时候就会对周围的人发火

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_226
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 谁都会紧张的啦~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_227
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 好~我们马上就去

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_228
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
呵呵……小立希，
能听到Afterglow的应援，太好了呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_229
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 观众们真是热情呢~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_230
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……等等，小灯

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_231
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 演出前，我想先说一下……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_232
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
就算今天的演出结束了……
今后，我们也要继续组乐队哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_233
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
初次见面，
我们是代替不能来的乐队参加演出的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_234
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我们也非常紧张和激动，
可以的话，希望大家能用温暖的目光关注我们

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_235
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不客气

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_236
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 大家，准备好了吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_237
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小爱音？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_238
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那么，接下来请欣赏
我们的歌曲

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_239
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
对不起，
其实我们是第一次演出……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_241
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（虽然她看起来比小爱音冷静，
但还是没法像之前那样……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_242
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （演出很不错呢……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_243
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （我们只有这一首歌，和大家打个招呼就结束吧）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_244
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （连小立希都……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_245
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （明明说了不演奏春日影的……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_246
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（诶……？
小祥？为什么……？）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_248
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……为什么啊

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_249
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 为什么要演奏『春日影』！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_250
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小祥哭了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_251
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你知道这样有多伤害她吗……！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_253
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
前些天吓了我一跳。
谁叫你突然和小祥一起来看我们的演出嘛

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_254
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 是小睦带她来的吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_255
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
既然小祥也一起来了，是不是表示，
你们对我们的事情持积极的态度呢？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_256
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……小睦，
你还真是想什么就说什么呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_257
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你总是做我不想让你做的事……
明明我拜托你做的事你都不肯做的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_258
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你知道小祥家在哪里吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_259
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
都是小睦的错哦。
无论是当时，还是现在

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_261
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 谢谢你今天能来

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_262
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……你不要生小睦的气哦。
是我强行让她带我来见小祥的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_263
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
因为我给你发了好多消息，
你都没有回复……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_264
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……对不起哦。
那天演出的事情……
我无论如何都想当面向你道歉……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_265
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
『春日影』……
其实我们没打算演奏的！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_266
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那天，我们只打算演奏一首歌……
我也不想这么做

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_267
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
但是，演奏既然开始了，
我也没有办法……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_268
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……对不起，
让小祥受伤了吧……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_269
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你不肯原谅我，也是正常的。
谁叫我擅自演奏了属于我们的重要歌曲呢……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_270
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 真的非常抱歉……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_271
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_272
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ！可是，春日影是CRYCHIC重要的——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_273
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
…………为什么？
为什么要说忘记？
我们以前的关系明明那么好

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_274
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
每天都很开心……每天都在一起……
现在却分开了，这样也太奇怪了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_275
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
乐队是命运共同体……
这句话，不是小祥说的吗

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_276
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……！不是的！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_278
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……求你了……
我想重组CRYCHIC！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_279
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我想回到我们那段快乐的时光！
小灯和小立希也是这么想的……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_280
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
组建那支乐队，
只是为了再次把CRYCHIC的大家聚集在一起……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_281
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我是打算
把小睦和小祥也一起喊回来的！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_283
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
为什么……？
只有我一个人这么想吗……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_284
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 但是，组建CRYCHIC的，是小祥哦……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_285
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ——没有结束！！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_286
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我……一直在
为了CRYCHIC而努力……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_288
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不是的，我真的
非常重视大家……非常喜欢大家！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_289
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……不要……求你了……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_290
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 如果没有小祥和小睦的话，我……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_291
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
要怎么做才能回到过去！？
只要是我能做的，我什么都可以做……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_293
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……但是，我是真的——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_295
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我记得，妈妈和爸爸离婚的时候，
我感到非常寂寞

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_296
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 虽然从那以后只有我和妈妈两个人一起生活……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_297
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 但妈妈工作得很努力，我们家变得非常富裕

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_298
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不仅搬进了漂亮的房子，生活也发生了很大的变化

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_299
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 但是，妈妈变得很忙，经常不回来

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_300
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 在漂亮的房子里，一直都只有我一个人

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_301
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 是妈妈希望我在月之森上学的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_302
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我想妈妈应该是对作为名门的月之森怀有憧憬吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_303
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 但是，对于一无所知的贵族女校，我心中很胆怯……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_304
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 哪怕在学校，我也依然是孤独的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_305
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
如果有人需要我的话，
或许寂寞就会消失吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_306
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我这样想着，开始做饭、洗衣服，
代替妈妈承担起家务

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_307
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
在同班同学邀请我加入的吹奏乐社，
我也努力练习了低音大提琴

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_308
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我开始被妈妈依赖，
在学校里也有了容身之处……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_309
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 但是，寂寞并没有消失

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_310
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
在我内心深处，
总觉得这里不是我该待的地方

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_311
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我想，寂寞是不是永远都不会消失呢。
直到那个时候……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_312
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
和小祥相遇，
是吹奏乐社在月之森音乐节上演奏结束后

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_313
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
毕竟她主动和我搭话了，如果能被需要的话……
这样想着，我决定加入乐队

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_314
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我对乐队没有特别的想法，
也没有期待，但是……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_315
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小祥的话，让我很兴奋

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_316
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这还是有生以来第一次有人对我提起命运这个词……
总觉得心里面有些痒痒的。
有种温暖的感觉

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_317
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 从那以后，我一直很开心

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_318
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我不知道为什么会是这几个女孩。
虽然大家也有很多合不来的地方，
但是……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_319
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
当我们五个人在一起的时候，
我从没感到寂寞

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_320
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
去卡拉OK，在录音棚练习，
在咖啡厅聊天，一起站在舞台上……
这些全都成了无可替代的回忆

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_321
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 然而……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_322
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那不是解散。
还没有结束

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_323
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我们只是意见上产生分歧而已，
一定能再和好的……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_324
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（哪怕已经过去了一年，
我仍然无法放弃CRYCHIC……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_325
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（CRYCHIC可以重新开始……
大家应该也是这样希望的……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_326
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我为了大家，一直……
一直…………

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_328
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 就……这样吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_329
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
正式演出是2点开始对吧。
要趁现在吃完午饭才行……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_331
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
对不起。
我好像忘带东西了，
你们先走吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_332
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你特意去问你姐姐了？
今天定期公演的事情

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_333
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 有什么事？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_334
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不知道。已经和我没关系了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_335
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 什么誓言……那只是谎言啦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_336
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 只是为了留住小立希和小灯的谎言

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_337
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我是不希望CRYCHIC的大家
再继续分开……
不过，没想到连小爱音和小乐奈都加入了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_338
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
只是因为她有用，我才对她温柔的，
但CRYCHIC并不需要那两个人呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_340
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 是啊

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_341
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 但是，小立希也没资格说别人吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_342
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小立希
只要有小灯在就行了吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_343
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不要跟着我

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_344
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 够了吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_345
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你打算跟着我到什么时候？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_346
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……这是我家

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_347
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
唉……算了。
你要进来吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_348
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我和妈妈一起住。
……我泡了茶

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_349
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……你居然还能这样和我说话。
我加入乐队的理由，你不是全都听说了吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_350
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……你是来吵架的吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_351
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 哈啊？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_352
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 什么意思。我不懂

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_353
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……你明明是为了虚荣心才组乐队的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_355
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……既然这样，就让我来结束它

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_356
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
等……等一下！
放手！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_357
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不要误会……！
我是为了结束才来的！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_358
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 为什么要我站在舞台上……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_359
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
等等！
就算给我贝斯……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_360
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……我到这里来，是为了结束一切的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_361
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
可是……为什么？
我已经搞不懂了……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_362
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我可是利用了大家啊！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_364
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 说什么一辈子，太傻了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_365
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……你们在聊什么？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_367
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那是突然被拉上去的即兴演出。
我可没法再重现一次

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_368
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我不会演奏『春日影』的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_369
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不是这个问题吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_370
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……取决于我们自己……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_371
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……参加也没关系吧？
反正脸都已经丢过了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_372
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……干吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_373
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……小灯很顽固呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_374
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
说什么……五个人一起演出。
如果我拒绝的话，她打算怎么办呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_376
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 这样啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_378
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_379
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 哈？Soyorin？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_380
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 别喊了！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_381
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 什么情况啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_382
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
怎么办？
结果现在新歌和演出服都没完成

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_383
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不勉强的话，时间来得及吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_384
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
话说，演出服呢？
虽然没有也可以，但你说要做的吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_385
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 跟没穿一样啊！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_386
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 而且乐队本来就不穿这种衣服吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_387
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 穿成这样是想参加什么啊

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_389
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……那要在我家讨论吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_390
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我去泡茶，你们随意

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_391
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……你们在干什么？
不是要写新歌吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_392
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我不太喜欢Soyorin这个名字呢~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_393
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我说了不喜欢吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_394
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 真是没品位

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_395
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你什么时候开始这么喊她的？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_396
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……我不是Soyorin

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_399
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小立希……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_401
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
也不知道是谁说想做演出服的。
明天就要演出了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_402
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
还要加工吗？
这样不就很好吗

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_403
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我就是因为怕赶不上才这么说的。
……如果要做的话，要把小灯也叫醒吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_404
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 说起来，歌词完成了是吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_405
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……明白了。
在那之前，只要帮你做演出服就行了，对吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_406
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
？基础服装……
标签上还缝着另一个标签……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_407
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 『ANON TOKYO』……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_408
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……我们还有该先做的事吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_410
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
现在不是说这种话的时候吧。
不赶紧过去，就来不及了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_411
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 是的，都到齐了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_412
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 轮到我出场的意思……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_413
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……那真不错。
不过，我们得快点上台了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_414
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 突然怎么了？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_415
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 这样很吓人啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_416
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小立希也跟上

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_417
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 介绍一下成员吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_419
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 乐队名也在中途变了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_420
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 『MyGO』，不是挺好的吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_421
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小爱音确实会做这种事呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_422
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……小灯

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_423
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 谢谢你没有放开我

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_0
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
小祥！
太好了~你来了！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_1
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我们一直都很担心你哦。
不仅学校那边请假，还完全不回消息——

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_2
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
等、等一下……
为什么？发生了什么事……？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_3
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……不能跟我们说？
还是说，是因为我们？
如果有做得不好的地方，我们可以改……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_4
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……为什么？
之前的演出，不是很开心吗。
你也说了还想再办的吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_5
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
没说、吗……？
但是，组建CRYCHIC的是小祥哦？
如果小祥退出的话……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_6
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 小立希，别这样——

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_7
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 小立希！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_8
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
等等……！我们好好谈谈吧，好不好？
大家好不容易开开心心走到现在……
小睦也是这么想的吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_9
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……怎么了？你没事吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_10
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_11
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
贵安，小睦。
你今天也在打理菜园吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_12
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 这是什么蔬菜？青椒吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_13
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 这样啊。真不愧是园艺社的呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_14
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
昨天，我去了RiNG……
但还是没见到小立希~

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_15
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……小睦那边怎么样？
给小祥发的消息，收到回复了吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_16
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
是吗……不回我就算了，
小睦可是她的发小，我还以为她会回呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_17
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
小祥现在在哪里呢。
也不知道她好不好

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_18
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
当时……小祥说要退出乐队的时候，
我要是……再多听她述说一下就好了

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_19
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 啊……对不起，小睦

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_20
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
也不是小睦的错哦。
不要太自责了，好不好？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_21
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
找时间，我去一趟小祥家吧。
小睦，你知道她住哪里吧。能告诉我吗

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_22
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 这样啊。谢谢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_23

ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
那么，接下来请欣赏
我们的歌曲

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_239
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
对不起，
其实我们是第一次演出……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_240
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_241
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
（虽然她看起来比小爱音冷静，
但还是没法像之前那样……）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_242
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: （演出很不错呢……）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_243
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: （我们只有这一首歌，和大家打个招呼就结束吧）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_244
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: （连小立希都……）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_245
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: （明明说了不演奏春日影的……）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_246
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
（诶……？
小祥？为什么……？）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_247
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_248
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……为什么啊

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_249
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 为什么要演奏『春日影』！？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_250
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 小祥哭了……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_251
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 你知道这样有多伤害她吗……！？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_252
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_253
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
前些天吓了我一跳。
谁叫你突然和小祥一起来看我们的演出嘛

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_254
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 是小睦带她来的吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_255
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
既然小祥也一起来了，是不是表示，
你们对我们的事情持积极的态度呢？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_256
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……小睦，
你还真是想什么就说什么呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_257
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
你总是做我不想让你做的事……
明明我拜托你做的事你都不肯做的

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_258
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 你知道小祥家在哪里吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_259
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
都是小睦的错哦。
无论是当时，还是现在

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_260
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_261
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 谢谢你今天能来

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_262
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……你不要生小睦的气哦。
是我强行让她带我来见小祥的

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_263
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
因为我给你发了好多消息，
你都没有回复……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_264
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……对不起哦。
那天演出的事情……
我无论如何都想当面向你道歉……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_265
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
『春日影』……
其实我们没打算演奏的！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_266
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
那天，我们只打算演奏一首歌……
我也不想这么做

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_267
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
但是，演奏既然开始了，
我也没有办法……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_268
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……对不起，
让小祥受伤了吧……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_269
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
你不肯原谅我，也是正常的。
谁叫我擅自演奏了属于我们的重要歌曲呢……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_270
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 真的非常抱歉……！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_271
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 诶？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_272
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ！可是，春日影是CRYCHIC重要的——

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_273
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
…………为什么？
为什么要说忘记？
我们以前的关系明明那么好

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_274
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
每天都很开心……每天都在一起……
现在却分开了，这样也太奇怪了

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_275
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
乐队是命运共同体……
这句话，不是小祥说的吗

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_276
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……！不是的！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_277
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_278
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……求你了……
我想重组CRYCHIC！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_279
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我想回到我们那段快乐的时光！
小灯和小立希也是这么想的……！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_280
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
组建那支乐队，
只是为了再次把CRYCHIC的大家聚集在一起……！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_281
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我是打算
把小睦和小祥也一起喊回来的！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_282
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_283
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
为什么……？
只有我一个人这么想吗……？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_284
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 但是，组建CRYCHIC的，是小祥哦……？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_285
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ——没有结束！！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_286
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我……一直在
为了CRYCHIC而努力……！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_287
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_288
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
不是的，我真的
非常重视大家……非常喜欢大家！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_289
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……不要……求你了……！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_290
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 如果没有小祥和小睦的话，我……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_291
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
要怎么做才能回到过去！？
只要是我能做的，我什么都可以做……！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_292
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_293
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……但是，我是真的——

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_294
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_295
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我记得，妈妈和爸爸离婚的时候，
我感到非常寂寞

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_296
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 虽然从那以后只有我和妈妈两个人一起生活……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_297
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 但妈妈工作得很努力，我们家变得非常富裕

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_298
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 不仅搬进了漂亮的房子，生活也发生了很大的变化

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_299
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 但是，妈妈变得很忙，经常不回来

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_300
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 在漂亮的房子里，一直都只有我一个人

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_301
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 是妈妈希望我在月之森上学的

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_302
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 我想妈妈应该是对作为名门的月之森怀有憧憬吧

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_303
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 但是，对于一无所知的贵族女校，我心中很胆怯……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_304
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 哪怕在学校，我也依然是孤独的

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_305
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
如果有人需要我的话，
或许寂寞就会消失吧

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_306
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我这样想着，开始做饭、洗衣服，
代替妈妈承担起家务

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_307
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
在同班同学邀请我加入的吹奏乐社，
我也努力练习了低音大提琴

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_308
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我开始被妈妈依赖，
在学校里也有了容身之处……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_309
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 但是，寂寞并没有消失

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_310
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
在我内心深处，
总觉得这里不是我该待的地方

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_311
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我想，寂寞是不是永远都不会消失呢。
直到那个时候……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_312
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
和小祥相遇，
是吹奏乐社在月之森音乐节上演奏结束后

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_313
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
毕竟她主动和我搭话了，如果能被需要的话……
这样想着，我决定加入乐队

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_314
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我对乐队没有特别的想法，
也没有期待，但是……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_315
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 小祥的话，让我很兴奋

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_316
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
这还是有生以来第一次有人对我提起命运这个词……
总觉得心里面有些痒痒的。
有种温暖的感觉

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_317
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 从那以后，我一直很开心

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_318
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我不知道为什么会是这几个女孩。
虽然大家也有很多合不来的地方，
但是……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_319
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
当我们五个人在一起的时候，
我从没感到寂寞

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_320
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
去卡拉OK，在录音棚练习，
在咖啡厅聊天，一起站在舞台上……
这些全都成了无可替代的回忆

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_321
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 然而……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_322
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
那不是解散。
还没有结束

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_323
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我们只是意见上产生分歧而已，
一定能再和好的……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_324
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
（哪怕已经过去了一年，
我仍然无法放弃CRYCHIC……）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_325
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
（CRYCHIC可以重新开始……
大家应该也是这样希望的……）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_326
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我为了大家，一直……
一直…………

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_327
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_328
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 就……这样吧

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_329
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
正式演出是2点开始对吧。
要趁现在吃完午饭才行……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_330
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_331
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
对不起。
我好像忘带东西了，
你们先走吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_332
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
你特意去问你姐姐了？
今天定期公演的事情

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_333
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 有什么事？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_334
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 不知道。已经和我没关系了

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_335
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 什么誓言……那只是谎言啦

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_336
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 只是为了留住小立希和小灯的谎言

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_337
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我是不希望CRYCHIC的大家
再继续分开……
不过，没想到连小爱音和小乐奈都加入了

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_338
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
只是因为她有用，我才对她温柔的，
但CRYCHIC并不需要那两个人呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_339
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_340
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 是啊

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_341
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 但是，小立希也没资格说别人吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_342
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
小立希
只要有小灯在就行了吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_343
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 不要跟着我

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_344
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 够了吧

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_345
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 你打算跟着我到什么时候？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_346
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……这是我家

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_347
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
唉……算了。
你要进来吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_348
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我和妈妈一起住。
……我泡了茶

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_349
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……你居然还能这样和我说话。
我加入乐队的理由，你不是全都听说了吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_350
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……你是来吵架的吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_351
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 哈啊？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_352
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 什么意思。我不懂

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_353
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……你明明是为了虚荣心才组乐队的

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_354
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_355
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……既然这样，就让我来结束它

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_356
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
等……等一下！
放手！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_357
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
不要误会……！
我是为了结束才来的！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_358
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 为什么要我站在舞台上……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_359
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
等等！
就算给我贝斯……！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_360
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……我到这里来，是为了结束一切的

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_361
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
可是……为什么？
我已经搞不懂了……！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_362
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 我可是利用了大家啊！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_363
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_364
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 说什么一辈子，太傻了……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_365
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……你们在聊什么？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_366
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_367
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
那是突然被拉上去的即兴演出。
我可没法再重现一次

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_368
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 我不会演奏『春日影』的

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_369
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 不是这个问题吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_370
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……取决于我们自己……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_371
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……参加也没关系吧？
反正脸都已经丢过了

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_372
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……干吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_373
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……小灯很顽固呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_374
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
说什么……五个人一起演出。
如果我拒绝的话，她打算怎么办呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_375
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_376
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 这样啊……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_377
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_378
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 诶？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_379
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 哈？Soyorin？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_380
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 别喊了！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_381
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 什么情况啊……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_382
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
怎么办？
结果现在新歌和演出服都没完成

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_383
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 不勉强的话，时间来得及吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_384
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
话说，演出服呢？
虽然没有也可以，但你说要做的吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_385
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 跟没穿一样啊！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_386
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 而且乐队本来就不穿这种衣服吧

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_387
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 穿成这样是想参加什么啊

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_388
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_389
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_soyo ws_voice_finished_12#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
